headline: On November 12, 2014: Philae lands on a comet
captionCards: First soft landing on a comet nucleus
instagramCaption:
Philae made history.

The European Space Agency's Philae lander touched down on Comet 67P/Churyumov–Gerasimenko. After bouncing twice due to failed harpoons and a non-firing thruster, it achieved the first soft landing on a comet nucleus. It transmitted data and images for 64 hours before going silent.

This milestone marked humanity’s first successful comet surface touchdown.
